segments.comment: Independent apply.c jump() witness for the mounted jump-in-place refusal: a debug dwarven Valkyrie forces a ride on a tame saddled horse (north, read from the C screen), wears wished-for jumping boots, enters #jump and selects her own square with '.', so C prints YMonnam(u.usteed) ('Your horse') before "isn't capable of jumping in place."
